## Problem 1

This problem uses data from a placebo-controlled clinical trial of
D-penicillamine (DPCA) for primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC).
PBC destroys bile ducts in the liver, causing bile to accumulate,
which causes progressive tissue damage and ultimately leads to liver failure.
The outcome in this study is time to death.
I'm not sure what the time origin is.
